summary: Read two strings made only of lowercase English letters. Each string has length at least 1 and at most 1000. Characters may be dropped from either string, but whatever stays must keep its original relative order. The two remaining pieces must be identical, and they should be as long as any legal choice allows. Write that shared length. If the strings have no matching non-empty piece, write 0.
notes: Compare after trimming trailing newlines. The input is tokens in the same order as the method parameters.
